goal: Add a non-blaming, release-only `review_target_superseded` terminal failure code so a reviewer lease stranded by a moved PR head can be released without recording a healthy provider as failed, and without weakening the exact-head release guard for any other code.
prohibited_actions: No hand-deletion of any lease, claim, contract or review ref, including the stranded refs/db-review-active-v2/grok-4.6/2744-2818-4ad729ff02e2792222b3130e09cbd64f386f6771.
No weakening or bypassing of the exact-head release guard, the verdict check, or any other guard for existing failure codes.
No migration author lane claim and no db-work issue changes.
No shared database reads or writes.
assumptions: Quarantine and retirement are static lists in code and no failure code feeds them automatically; the only code-driven provider penalty is the replacement redraw's failed-on-this-head set, which the new code never reaches because replacement refuses it.
stop_conditions: Stop if releasing a superseded lease would require relaxing the exact-head guard for any other failure code.
Stop and report the exact refusal if a required governed tool refuses, rather than working around it.
